name: Phyto Chem (India) Limited
about: Phyto Chem (India) Limited manufactures and markets pesticides for the agriculture sector in India. It operates through two segments: Pesticides Formulations and Real Estate. The company provides liquid and SC, weedicide, wettable and powder, and granule formulations. It also offers insecticides, synthetic pyrethroids, fungicides, acaricides, antibiotics, and plant growth regulators and promotors. In addition, the company is involved in the real estate activities. It markets its products through dealers and a network of distributors. Phyto Chem (India) Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
